mechanicalPrinciples.rollType: Five Force Powers use Use the Force; four have fixed tier ladders, and Repulse uses opposed Strength (no fixed DC). Techniques, Secrets and Unleashed overlays do not roll independently.
mechanicalPrinciples.tierSelection: Choose highest published fixed floor; Corruption also meets modified Fortitude; Force Blast must strictly exceed Reflex; Storm tiers control duration only.

Active Storm pulses do not grant additional Force Training uses
Unleashed modes are paid options, not new owned power instances

mechanicalPrinciples.errataPriority: Printed FUCG p85-90 are authoritative pending verifiable official correction. Unleashed feat p35 gating is mandatory.

unresolvedSourceInterpretations.issue: Corruption delayed half damage — FUCG p86 repeats next-turn half-damage language after one half-damage clause; ambiguous whether duplicate tick or editorial redundancy. Proposed: One delayed half-damage tick for a hit target, with Unleashed extending to five total ticks.

Debilitating Power DP threshold — FUCG p89 says UTF >= damage threshold for the FP extra condition step, then Alternative DP to -3. Proposed: Same UTF threshold gate for both resource choices pending editorial confirmation.

Unleashed Force Grip fractional Charisma modifier — FUCG p90 uses half Charisma modifier (minimum one round); does not explicitly state fractional rounding. Proposed: Math floor for positive odd modifiers; do not claim printed rounding is explicit.

Unleashed Force Storm with FP damage bonus — FUCG p86 FP +2d6; p90 Unleashed sets storm to 8d6. Proposed: Do not silently stack +2d6 and 8d6 on same pulse; force explicit spend choice and modifier precedence.

Improved Force Grip plus Unleashed Force Grip — FUCG p88 technique says no resuming concentration after its free one-round extension; p90 Unleashed says no action for half Cha modifier rounds. Proposed: Treat as distinct modes; no automatic chaining.

Power of the Dark Side and Wrath of the Dark Side source behavior — FUCG p88 Wrath changes natural-20 suite recovery, is conditional on directly damaging powers. Proposed: No direct damage => cannot replace natural 20 recovery.
Kinetic Combat origin — KOTOR p51 and FUCG p86 both print same base power. Proposed: Reprint only: identity kotor/force-power/kinetic-combat; do not count as sixth FUCG power.

No independently verified FUCG Force-domain errata found — PDF p85-91 checked; available web errata snippets did not establish a correction for any of these 31 definitions. Proposed: Treat printed book as authority and retain clarification watch; do not assume no errata exists.

reprints.notes: Detailed kinetic combat reprint (including +1 FP attack and maintenance) agrees with KOTOR p51; keep KOTOR origin and source lineage.
